meta.title: Sofood Kaz — dairy processing complex in Konaev, part of Solico Group
meta.description: Sofood Kaz is building a dairy processing complex in Konaev, Kazakhstan: a cheese plant with 40,920 tonnes of products a year, 400 jobs and milk from farms in the Almaty and Zhetisu regions. Part of Solico Group.
meta.ogAlt: Sofood Kaz: milk from Almaty and Zhetisu farms, cheese made in Konaev

hero.title: Milk from Almaty and Zhetisu farms. Cheese made in Konaev.
hero.lead: Sofood Kaz is building a dairy processing complex in Konaev. The cheese plant comes first, followed by three more production sites and a packaging area. The project is backed by Solico Group, the food holding behind the Kalleh brand.

project.label: 01 — The project
project.title: What we are building in Konaev
paragraphs: Phase one is a cheese plant with a capacity of 40,920 tonnes of products a year. It will make cream, hard and brined cheeses, ultrafiltered cheese, cream cheese, labneh and mozzarella.
The full complex is phase one plus three more production sites and a packaging area of about 4 hectares. Central and technical warehouses and the utilities sit on the same site.

The project runs under an investment agreement with the Ministry of Agriculture of the Republic of Kazakhstan. On 22 October 2026 the plans were presented to the Prime Minister at the Kazakhstan Global Investment Roundtable (KGIR-2026).

chain.label: 02 — From farm to shelf
chain.title: Local milk, processing in Konaev, markets across the region

columns.title: Farms in the Almaty and Zhetisu regions
columns.text: About 91,700 tonnes of raw milk a year, mainly from farms in the Almaty and Zhetisu regions.

columns.title: The Konaev complex
columns.text: The cheese plant first, then yogurt, sour cream and butter production, warehouses and packaging on one site.

columns.title: Kazakhstan and export
columns.text: About half of the output is for the Kazakhstan market. Up to 50% is planned for export to Central Asia, Russia and Azerbaijan.

solico.label: 03 — Solico Group
solico.title: A food company that started with one workshop in 1971
paragraphs: Solico Group produces, distributes and sells food in more than 10 countries: dairy, ice cream, ready meals, beverages and snacks, for retail and food service. It is one of the largest food processing operations in the Middle East.
The group runs its own supply chain: raw materials (milk is the largest), transport, production and direct distribution to shops. Its global headquarters is in Dubai, UAE.
Its best-known brand, Kalleh, is already sold in Kazakhstan. Sofood Kaz is the group's production company in Kazakhstan.
solico.founder: Founder: Gholamali Soleimani, born in 1946 in Amol, Iran. He started with a small hamburger workshop and grew the business into meat, dairy and many other food categories.
